description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the 'Download' model in the Opencart system, specifically within the 'Account' namespace. It provides methods to fetch individual download details, list downloads, get total download counts, and add download reports, indicating it manages customer download-related data.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: Model class responsible for managing downloads associated with customer orders, including retrieving download details, counting downloads, and logging download reports.

methods.name: getDownload
methods.description: Fetches specific download information based on a provided download ID, considering order statuses and customer permissions.

methods.name: getDownloads
methods.description: Retrieves a list of downloads, supporting pagination through start and limit parameters, with filtering based on order status, store, and language.

methods.name: getTotalDownloads
methods.description: Returns the total count of downloads for the current customer, filtered by completed order statuses.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Logs a report of a download event, recording the download ID, customer IP, and optional country information.
